title: MFS Limited - proposed acquisition of S8 Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC announced its decision not to oppose the proposed acquisition

body_sections.Summary: MFS Limited and S8 Limited have operations in the tourism accommodation industry.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the following markets in its review of MFS Limited's proposed acquisition of S8 Limited: - a national market for the provision of management letting services to apartment owners; and - a Gold Coast market for the provision of accommodation services.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that MFS Limited would face sufficient competitive constraints post-acquisition and that the proposed acquisition is unlikely to cause a substantial lessening of competition in any of the relevant markets. This conclusion was informed by the following factors: - moderate barriers to entry and expansion in relevant markets; - regulatory pricing constraints faced by management letting service providers when providing services to apartment owners; and - available substitutes in the Gold Coast for the provision of accommodation services.
